title: Mission Screenshot Core
description: A four-image mission sequence that behaves like believable in-engine gameplay rather than poster art.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the mission space, HUD framing, and playable viewpoint. Images 02-04 progress the same mission through combat, capture, and extraction.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-mission-intro-screen first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-combat-beat-screen, 03-objective-capture-screen, 04-loot-extract-screen. Queue may run 02-combat-beat-screen, 03-objective-capture-screen, 04-loot-extract-screen concurrently after 01-mission-intro-screen is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
